evidence.detail: Command body is a single 'Temporarily disabled' send; all real logic is commented out

Configure disabled here during slash-command migration; old code used ctx.author.guild_permissions.MANAGE_CHANNELS (MANAGE_CHANNELS check) which is now replaced by @check(is_owner()), an entirely different permission model that only allows the bot owner
Commented-out code accesses ctx.author.guild_permissions, ctx.channel.guild.id — need to verify these still work with current interactions library before uncommenting

triage.notes: The re-enable is non-trivial: the permissions model was deliberately changed from guild MANAGE_CHANNELS to is_owner() during the migration. Restoring server-manager configurability requires deciding which check to use and verifying the interactions-library API for guild_permissions is still valid.
